title: FeaturePlanningOutput
description: Output schema for the feature-planning skill (v2.3.0+). Adds uncertainty_markers and new_external_dependencies fields required by TASK-0075 / B-4 fix. These fields trigger phase-4b-research when non-empty.

uncertainty_markers.description: B-4 fix (TASK-0075): Planner MUST emit this field. Each entry represents a place in the plan where an uncertainty marker was used. Values matching /^(TBD|UNVERIFIED|ASSUMPTION|UNCLEAR|NEEDS_RESEARCH)$/i in any task field MUST be extracted and listed here. When this array is non-empty, phase-4b-research is triggered.

marker_text.description: The exact marker token. Case-insensitive match required.

task_id.description: ID of the task containing the marker.

field_path.description: JSONPath notation for the field containing the marker. Example: 'tasks[3].description' or 'tasks[0].acceptance_criteria[1]'.

context.description: The surrounding text or full field value containing the marker. Provides context for the research phase.

new_external_dependencies.description: B-4 fix (TASK-0075): Planner MUST emit this field. Lists all external packages, libraries, or services introduced in this plan that were not present in the existing dependency graph. When non-empty, phase-4b-research is triggered to assess license, security, and maturity.

version.description: Required version or version range. Use semver range notation (^, ~, exact) or 'latest' only when no constraint is known — 'latest' triggers an UNVERIFIED marker automatically.

source.description: Package registry or service origin. Examples: 'npm', 'pypi', 'crates.io', 'maven-central', 'https://github.com/org/repo', 'vendor'.

introduced_by_task_id.description: Task ID that first requires this dependency.

purpose.description: Brief explanation of why this dependency is needed.

effort_total_sp.description: Total story points summed across all tasks.

critical_path_task_ids.description: Ordered list of task IDs forming the critical path.
